title: The Diagonal Collects
setup: Black handed over the center and two pawns with it, and White has just recaptured on c3 with the b-pawn.
hint: White recaptured with a pawn that only one piece is guarding, and your bishop has been aimed at it since move four.
explanation:
## The Idea

The bishop on g7 has been aimed down the long diagonal since move four, and this is what it was waiting for.

{{Bxc3+}} takes a pawn back with check. {{Rxc3}} runs into {{Qxc3+}}, because the queen on a5 stands behind the bishop, and {{Qd2}} drops the queen to {{Bxd2+}}. White's best is {{Ke2}}, giving up castling to stay a pawn up.

Give up the center only when you have something to shoot at it with.
